description: This file defines asynchronous flow control functions for handling notes within the application, including creating, updating, deleting, and listing notes. It serves as an application service layer orchestrating calls to repository functions and handling logging.

methods.name: tuple[notes_repo.NoteRow,list[notes_repo.TagRow]] create_note_flow( session: AsyncSession, *, title: str, content: str, is_archived: bool, tag_ids: list[UUID], tag_names: list[str], )
methods.description: Creates a new note with optional tags, ensuring tags by name, attaching them, and returning the note and associated tags.

methods.name: tuple[notes_repo.NoteRow,list[notes_repo.TagRow]] update_note_flow( session: AsyncSession, *, note_id: UUID, title: str | None, content: str | None, is_archived: bool | None, tag_ids: list[UUID] | None, tag_names: list[str] | None, )
methods.description: Updates an existing note with new data, optionally replacing tags, and returns the updated note and tags.

methods.name: tuple[notes_repo.NoteRow,list[notes_repo.TagRow]] get_note_flow(session: AsyncSession, *, note_id: UUID)
methods.description: Retrieves a note along with its associated tags by note ID.

methods.name: tuple[list[notes_repo.NoteRow],dict[UUID,list[notes_repo.TagRow]],int] list_notes_flow( session: AsyncSession, *, q: str | None, tag_id: UUID | None, include_archived: bool, limit: int, offset: int, )
methods.description: Lists notes according to provided filters such as query string, tag ID, archival status, with pagination support.
